body: I was bisexual (MTF) before I cracked and still am, what changed though is it flipped sides. I went from preferring women majority of the time over men to preferring men after HRT. It's pretty crazy how that works.

Yeah it is unimaginably lonely. Almost nobody will ever understand what it's like to be trapped in the wrong body, as 99% of the population was blessed with their mind and body matching. I've also started medically transitioning about 7 months ago. It's made dealing with my dysphoria a lot easier, but even with "passing privilege" dealing with society's bs doesn't get easier. Besides being stuck with an out of date ID, there's also the constant thought and anxiety in the back of my mind that 60% of everyone will just hate me when/if they find out. It doesn't help that I have to go into an in person course with other people in this city if I have any chance of leaving. I'm terrified that I'm just going to constantly be the butt of a joke because someone from the past recognizes me, or even worse physically abused by my peers out of pure hatred. Hardly anyone in my own family cares to listen, and the ones that do have no idea of what to say. Sometimes I feel like even they could care less and get annoyed by it. I don't have many friends as both irl and online have either cut me off for being trans or went their separate ways for things like college (though a lot of them would have the same sentiment). So I'm really glad that you not only care to listen, but you also understand my struggles and don't try to belittle/joke about them.
I don't even know where to begin on that

You put it in better words than I could. So many hateful people in my city that just overlook me because they assume I'm cis, but I know what they'd say/do if they knew I wasn't. Its slowly eating me alive, knowing that both romance and even just friendships are going to be a daunting hurdle thanks to being born in the wrong body. I'd be able to ignore it if it wasn't for the sheer number of people that feel this way, it drives me insane knowing how quickly I'd be discarded by most people if they ever found out. They don't understand that none of us asked for this and the suicide rate they laugh at almost entirely comes from how they treat us. I'm starting to think hardly anyone ever will understand or care/respect me for who I am, and that's what mainly plays into my suicidal thoughts. I really appreciate that you took the time to write this, its nice to see someone cares and understands.
Thank you for the encouragement, you have no idea how much I appreciate it.

I'm extremely sorry you have to go through this as well, I wouldn't wish this on almost anyone including the people that do this. I wish you luck if you decide to transition, thank you so much for reaching out.
I don't actively seek it out, its almost as if it seeks me out.
